method: WebFetch of each course's own st-andrews.ac.uk subject page (fees and funding section), plus the undergraduate fees hubs on st-andrews.ac.uk. The Chemistry and Physics MSci URL in the input 404s; the current page (same UCAS code FF13, titled 'Chemistry and Physics MSci (Hons) 2027 entry') is https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/subjects/chemistry/chemistry-mchem/chemistry-and-physics-joint/. One un-parameterised fetch of that page returned an old copy (all three categories 'not yet confirmed'); fetches with ?v=2 and ?v=3 both showed the figures below, so the stale copy was discarded. A further re-fetch (?v=4) was refused by the fetch proxy (HTTP 429), so it could not be checked a fourth time.
